role: Plain value types carrying last night's sleep and multi-night sleep trend into AnalysisSummaryGenerator; built by MorningResultsViewModel from SleepData / SleepTrendStats.
types: AnalysisSleepInput: struct — one night's sleep minutes/stages/efficiency plus short/good/fragmented gates against HRVThresholds
AnalysisSleepTrendInput: struct — averaged sleep trend over N nights
toplevel: Two static `empty` instances built via the memberwise inits (AnalysisSleepInputs.swift:36-40, 76-79).

flags.text: AnalysisSleepTrendInput.SleepTrend re-declares the four cases of the SleepTrendStats.SleepTrend enum and init(from:) maps them 1:1, a second copy that must be kept in sync by hand.

units.does: True when the night has some sleep but fewer than HRVThresholds.sleepShortMinutes (300) minutes; a 0-minute (no data) night is not short.

flags.text: The same short-sleep (0 < night < 300) and fragmented (awake > 30) gates are re-implemented inline in ContextBuilder for the assistant context instead of reusing AnalysisSleepInput; a threshold change in one copy will not reach the other.

units.does: Memberwise initializer storing the six sleep fields; used to build `.empty`.

Builds the input from a HealthKit-resolved SleepData: total = nightSleepMinutes (nap excluded), inBed, deep, rem, awake, and measuredSleepEfficiency (nil when wake unmeasured). Called from MorningResultsViewModel.swift:312.

branches.effect: true: self = .empty (all zeros/nil) and return; false: copy fields from the SleepData

units.does: Memberwise initializer for the trend input; used to build `.empty`.
Builds the trend input from HealthKitManager.SleepTrendStats (averages, nightsAnalyzed) and maps its trend enum case-for-case. Called from MorningResultsViewModel.swift:313.

branches.effect: true: self = .empty (0 avg, trend .insufficient, 0 nights); false: copy fields
